H7225.definition: First, chief, beginning time, primary source or firstfruits.
H7225.origin: From the same as H7218 (ראש - rosh: head, chief)
H7225.usage: Occurs 50 times in the Old Testament. Used to denote the absolute beginning of time, chief part, and consecrated firstfruits unto Yahweh.

H1254.definition: To create, shape, or form out of nothing (ex nihilo). An action uniquely attributed to Divine power.
H1254.origin: A primitive root term meaning to create out of non-existence
H1254.usage: Occurs 54 times in the OT. Exclusively reserved for God's sovereign creation of the universe, heavens, earth, and mankind.

H430.definition: God, the Supreme Divine Being, Creator and Ruler of the universe. Plural of majesty.
H430.origin: Plural of H433 (אֱלוֹהַּ - Eloah); derived from H410 (El: mighty one)
H430.usage: Occurs 2,602 times in the Old Testament. Highlights God's omnipotence, majesty, and supreme governance over creation.

H853.definition: Direct object pointer in Hebrew grammar; also signifies completeness (from Aleph to Tav).
H853.origin: Appears as a grammatical marker introducing definite direct objects
H853.usage: Occurs over 7,000 times in the Hebrew Scriptures. Points to the direct focus of divine action.

H8064.definition: The heavens, sky, visible atmosphere, and celestial abode of God.
H8064.origin: From a dual of an unused root meaning to be lofty or high
H8064.usage: Occurs 420 times in the OT. Denotes the visible cosmos as well as the dwelling place of the Most High.

H776.definition: The earth, land, ground, physical country, or world.
H776.origin: From an unused root probably meaning to be firm
H776.usage: Occurs 2,504 times in the OT. References the created physical globe, the promised land of Canaan, and all human territory.

H3068.definition: The Covenant Name of God: 'I AM WHO I AM'. The Eternal, Self-Existent, Uncreated LORD.
H3068.origin: From H1961 (הָיָה - hayah: to exist, be)
H3068.usage: Occurs 6,519 times in the OT. The sacred Tetragrammaton representing God's unchangeable faithfulness to His covenant people.

H7462.definition: To tend, pasture, shepherd, feed, and guide a flock with personal affection.
H7462.origin: From H7462 (רָעָה - ra'ah: to pasture, associate with)
H7462.usage: Occurs 173 times in the OT. Used of Yahweh as the loving Shepherd of Israel in Psalm 23:1.

G3056.definition: Divine Expression, Word, Mind, Reason, or Revelation. Personified as Jesus Christ, the Living Word of God.
G3056.origin: From G3004 (λέγω - lego: to speak systematically)
G3056.usage: Occurs 330 times in the NT. Used by John to declare Jesus as the pre-existent, uncreated Word made flesh (John 1:1, 1:14).

G746.definition: Beginning, origin, primary source, chief rule, or first principle.
G746.origin: From G757 (ἄρχω - archo: to be first in time or order)
G746.usage: Occurs 58 times in the NT. Denotes primordial origin before time began (John 1:1) and Christ as the Ruler of Creation.

G2316.definition: God, the One Supreme Deity, Creator of heaven and earth.
G2316.origin: Of uncertain affinity; denotes the Divine Supreme Sovereign
G2316.usage: Occurs 1,317 times in the NT. Denotes God the Father, Son, and Holy Spirit in divine unity.

G25.definition: Selfless, unconditional, sacrificial divine love (Agape). Loving without expectation of return.
G25.usage: Occurs 143 times in the NT. Describes God's unconditional love in giving His Son for humanity (John 3:16).

G2889.definition: The world, human society, creation, or order. The realm of humanity loved by God.
G2889.origin: From G2865 (κομίζω - komizo: to take care of or adorn)
G2889.usage: Occurs 186 times in the NT. Refers to the inhabited earth and lost humanity for whom Christ died.

G5485.definition: Grace, unmerited divine favor, spiritual blessing, dynamic power bestowed freely by God.
G5485.origin: From G5463 (χαίρω - chairo: to rejoice, be glad)
G5485.usage: Occurs 156 times in the NT. The foundational gospel truth of salvation by grace through faith (Ephesians 2:8, Rev 22:21).

G2962.definition: Lord, Master, Owner, Sovereign Ruler. The NT equivalent of YHWH.
G2962.usage: Occurs 717 times in the NT. Used to confess Jesus as Supreme Lord over heaven and earth.

G281.definition: Truly, verily, so be it, firm, trustworthy affirmation.
G281.origin: Of Hebrew origin H543 (אָמֵן - amen: truth, certainty)
G281.usage: Occurs 129 times in the NT. Used to seal prayers, confirm divine truth, and express unshakeable faith.
